concerns.text: The validation step ‘conduct a CI‑overlap check between the 1 ns and 10 ns intervals’ (FR-008 / SC-005) is not a statistically rigorous test of difference. Overlapping confidence intervals do not guarantee non‑significance, and non‑overlap does not correspond to a specific α‑level. Replace or supplement this with a proper hypothesis test (e.g., paired bootstrap difference test, permutation test, or a t‑test on the MAE values) to assess whether the accuracy at 1 ns differs from that at 10 ns.
